  • Lead the operational rollout and adoption of digitisation, system upgrades and robotics/automation initiatives, working closely with the COO.
  • Optimise existing automation and system-led workflows to improve stock flow, replenishment, picking and operational efficiency.
  • Lead the adoption of new systems, policies, procedures and SOPs, ensuring changes are understood and embedded across the operation.
  • Identify opportunities to digitise manual processes, improve workflows and use automation to increase productivity, accuracy and scalability.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs, using operational data to identify bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement.
  • Partner with the COO and key stakeholders to align technology, processes and people with future business requirements.
  • Lead and develop a large operational team through change, building accountability, capability and engagement.
  • Maintain strong standards across inventory, quality, safety, compliance and risk management.

About You
You are an experienced Operations Manager, Warehouse Manager, Distribution Manager or similar operational leader who understands the warehouse floor and has improved performance through people, systems and automation.

You will bring:
  • Experience leading warehouse, distribution, logistics or manufacturing operations.
  • Direct experience working with warehouse automation and improving its performance, utilisation or supporting workflows.
  • Experience implementing, upgrading or optimising ERP or warehouse management systems (WMS), including embedding system-led processes.
  • Strong change-management skills, including training and supporting teams through new technology, processes and ways of working.
  • Strong analytical and KPI-management capability, with examples of operational improvements.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing large operational teams, with a practical, people-focused approach.
  • Your automation background could include goods-to-person systems, automated picking, conveyors, robotics or comparable warehouse technology. Relevant experience may include optimising existing automation, onboarding products or customers into automated environments, or supporting system implementations and upgrades.
  • You don’t need an exclusively manufacturing background. What matters is your ability to adapt your experience to different operational requirements and deliver improvements across people, processes and technology.

Working closely with four direct reports across warehouse operations, transport, inventory and New Zealand operations, you will play an important role in ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day activities while identifying opportunities to improve service, efficiency and cost performance.

  • Work with internal teams across sales, marketing, finance, IT, planning and customer service to coordinate stock requirements, promotions and new product launches.
  • Improve fulfilment processes and the customer delivery experience, including online orders, returns, collection channels and last-mile delivery.
  • Support the effective use of ERP and warehouse systems, ensuring data accuracy and reliable information across operational processes.

You are an operations or logistics professional who combines sound operational knowledge with the ability to lead people, solve problems and improve performance. You are comfortable managing day to day priorities while looking for practical ways to make processes more efficient.
 
To be successful, you will bring:
 
  • Experience in operations, logistics, warehousing, distribution or fulfilment management, ideally within retail, FMCG, e-commerce or a similar environment.
